_comment: Fixed rosters for the 2026-fall league (Aug 1 -- Dec 31, 2026).
Roster fields (per player):
name    -- CANONICAL display_name (matches Steam scoreboard). Used for
team inference on ingested screenshots and for individual stats.
role    -- 'core' | 'support' | 'stand_in'. 5 non-stand_in per team.
aka     -- friendly nicknames used by !register so players don't have to
know the canonical Steam name ('Cpx' -> 'Mandark [<MC>]').
The Teams tab DISPLAYS aka[0] with the canonical underneath,
so the sheet's nickname is what people actually read.
backup  -- optional. Canonical name of the stand-in who can substitute
FOR THIS SLOT, or a LIST of them. Slots without `backup`
can't be filled by anyone -- the primary must play.
2026-08-08 RESHUFFLE -- the league went from FOUR teams to FIVE.
From the captains' sheet, whose columns B/C/D are cores and E/F are
supports. Changes against the previous sheet:
1. TEAM 5 IS NEW: Axo, Eros, Rogue Agent (cores), Eldritch, Musa
(supports).
2. Rogue Agent moved from Team 4 to Team 5. He had already played 5
recorded league games FOR TEAM 4, which is exactly why every
match in data/league_matches.json now carries a frozen
radiant_team_id / dire_team_id (league_ingest.py --freeze-teams).
Rosters describe who plays next, never who played last.
3. Gillu was a Team 4 stand-in and is now a Team 4 CORE.
4. Musa was a Team 4 stand-in and is now a Team 5 SUPPORT.
5. Team 1's roles swapped: Obnoxious is now a core and samundar khan
('XXX') a support. The five people are unchanged.
6. Team 1's first support slot reads 'Soma / Tiger-Y' on the sheet --
one slot, either player. Tiger-Y is Scarface [FUBU], so he is that
slot's backup rather than a sixth starter.
Teams 2 and 3 are unchanged.

Team 4 'Gillu'    (never appeared on any scoreboard)
Team 5 'Eros'     (never appeared on any scoreboard)
Team 5 'Eldritch' (never appeared on any scoreboard)
Axo was found: he is 'axo [EGAN]', 1 game in the lobby ledger.
STAND-INS ARE KEPT EVEN WHEN THE SHEET DROPS THEM. Removing one
breaks league_result.stand_ins, and a side that legitimately fielded
them becomes 'a player on no roster' -- which would refuse a game
already recorded. Scarface [FUBU] filled a Team 1 slot on 7 Aug and a
Team 3 slot on 8 Aug; both are in the ledger.
A NAME MAY MAP TO EXACTLY ONE TEAM. league_result.team_index is a flat
dict, so a second entry wins or loses by iteration order. Shared
stand-ins therefore sit on one roster and appear in other teams'
`backup` lists, which are display-only.
open_pool: players who registered via `!register` in Discord but aren't
on any team's fixed roster. Captains can pull from the pool for stand-ins.
The pool is written by tools/discord_league.py, never by hand.
